items.question: What services does mmoving.de offer in Munich?
items.answer: mmoving.de brings together three services for Munich and the surrounding area: moving (SuperUmzug), clearance and house clearances (Entrümpelung München), and renovation and refurbishment (BayReno). You can book each service on its own or all three as a full service with a single point of contact.

items.question: Which area do you cover?
items.answer: Munich and roughly 50 km around it — including Dachau, Freising, Erding, Ebersberg, Starnberg, Fürstenfeldbruck, Germering, Unterschleißheim, Garching and Holzkirchen, plus the entire Munich district. Long-distance moves are handled Germany-wide.

items.question: What does a move with clearance in Munich cost?
items.answer: It depends on volume, area and scope. Typical market rates are €700–2,800 for a move within Munich and €35–70 per square metre for a clearance. As a combined job you typically save 15 to 25 %. Your binding price follows a short survey.

items.question: What does the inspection service cost?
items.answer: €290 as a flat fee. It covers a joint walkthrough of the property, a systematic condition assessment of every room, a realistic cost estimate for your target condition and a difficulty rating per item. It is bookable independently of any package.

items.question: What is the damage-free guarantee?
items.answer: Our service promise on moves: if anything is damaged during the move, we reimburse its full value. We document the condition of valuable items before and after transport so any claim is reviewed quickly and fairly.

items.question: How quickly can I get an appointment?
items.answer: Short-notice clearance dates are often available within a few days. For moves we recommend two to three weeks of lead time, or four to six weeks for month-end dates between June and September. The callback form lets you choose “as soon as possible”.

items.question: Do I get a fixed price or is it charged by the hour?
items.answer: After the survey you receive a written fixed price, including travel, crew, materials and — for clearances — all disposal fees. We do not add charges on the day.

items.question: Do you work with property managers and corporate clients?
items.answer: Yes. Referral partners such as estate agents and property managers receive a commission; corporate clients with recurring needs get fixed partner rates and priority scheduling. Details are on our B2B page.
